card.title: IPhone 8 No Backlight or Dark Spot On Screen Repair

source.title: IPhone 8 No Backlight or Dark Spot On Screen Repair

claims.statement: iPhone 8 / 8 Plus no backlight is usually blown backlight filters: R5733, R5734, R5735 on iPhone 8; R5730–R5733 and R5735 on 8 Plus.
Liquid damage at the Taptic Engine can kill backlight, since it is wired through the charge port flex; test with the charge port unplugged.
Never jumper a filter; replace with the same value.

procedure: Confirm board fault; test with charge port unplugged.
Diode-check backlight pins on LCD connector against boardview.
Find and replace the blown filter.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Jumpering a filter removes surge protection.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
